Glossary

Call to action: what is it, exactly?

A call to action, often shortened to CTA, is an element that clearly invites the visitor to do something: a “Call” button, a “Request a quote” link, a “Book your table” sentence. It is the bridge between interest and contact.

The definition in one sentence

In French, it is called an appel à l’action. It is the point where the site stops informing and suggests a next step. Most often it is a clearly visible button, in a different colour from the rest of the page.

What it does for a small business

An interested visitor will not search for long to find how to contact you. If they cannot see straight away what to do, they close the page and move on. A good call to action shows them the way at the moment they are ready.

A real-life example

A roofer has a nice, complete website. Right at the bottom, in small print, there is one line: “To reach us, see the contact page”. By adding a “Call” button at the top of every page, which starts the call on a phone, and a “Get a free quote” button at the end of each page, he makes the next step obvious without changing anything else.

How to write a good call to action

  • An action verb: call, book, order, get, discover.
  • What the person gets: “Get my quote” says more than “Send”.
  • Short: two to five words, readable at a glance.
  • Reassuring if needed: “no commitment”, “reply within 48 hours”, but only if it is true.

Where to put it

  • At the top of the page, visible without scrolling.
  • After each key section, just when the visitor has been won over.
  • At the end of the page, for those who have read everything.
  • Fixed at the bottom of the screen on phones, for a trade where a phone call is the main way in.

Common mistakes

  • Too many different buttons on the same page. Visitors no longer know which one to pick.
  • Vague buttons like “Find out more” everywhere.
  • A button that leads nowhere, or to a broken form.
  • A colour that blends into the background.

Every page should have one main action. Ask yourself: if the visitor does only one thing here, what do I want it to be?

Your questions

Can a phone number work as a call to action?

Yes, if it can be tapped on a phone and is well highlighted. For many tradespeople and local shops, it is even the most effective.

What colour should a button be?

A colour that stands out well against the background and suits the spirit of your website. What matters most is contrast and consistency: the same style for all the main actions.
